title: Implementation of Machine Translation for the Uzbek Language Based on Transformer Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.32359v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This research focuses on building a machine translation system for the Uzbek language using transformer models such as T5 and mT5. Because of the limited data and the complexity of the Uzbek language, we collect, preprocess and augment data to create a strong Uzbek-English parallel corpus of about 3 million sentence pairs. The models are fine-tuned for optimal translation performance, and we use the BLEU score to evaluate the results. This study shows that our approach significantly improves upon older methods and helps promote the Uzbek language in the digital world.

translated_title: 基于Transformer模型的乌兹别克语机器翻译的实现
translated_abstract: 本研究聚焦于使用T5和mT5等Transformer模型构建乌兹别克语机器翻译系统。由于数据有限以及乌兹别克语本身的复杂性，我们收集、预处理并扩充数据，构建了一个包含约300万句对的高质量乌兹别克语-英语平行语料库。我们对模型进行微调以获得最佳翻译性能，并使用BLEU分数对结果进行评估。这项研究表明，我们的方法相比旧方法有显著提升，并有助于在数字世界中推广乌兹别克语。
tldr: 本研究通过构建约300万句对的乌兹别克语-英语平行语料库，并基于T5和mT5等Transformer模型进行微调，实现了显著优于传统方法的乌兹别克语机器翻译系统。
en_tdlr: This study builds an Uzbek-English parallel corpus of about 3 million sentence pairs and fine-tunes Transformer models (T5 and mT5) to achieve machine translation for Uzbek that significantly outperforms older methods.
